messages.subject: Quartz — post-completion filings & company books
messages.plaintextBody:
Priya,

Post-completion housekeeping: we've filed the SH01 (return of allotment), the amended articles and the AP01 for Aisha's appointment at Companies House. Updated registers of members and PSC are attached to the completion bundle. Share certificates for the Series A shares have been issued.

One open item from the DD: the outstanding contractor IP assignment — please let us know when the deed is executed so we can close it out.

Elena

Elena Marchetti
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
